name: cyber_theme
author: 官方团队
description: 高对比度暗黑背景，隐藏路线详情，让地图与搜索变得纯粹。

name: minimal_mode
author: 官方团队
description: 去除一切干扰元素，隐藏周边探索和路线面板，只保留地图与全局搜索。

name: big_text_mode
author: 官方团队
description: 放大全局字体，隐藏复杂交互，适合视力不佳的用户使用。

name: light_pro_plus
author: 轻艺团队
description: 由「轻艺」团队打造。专为浅色模式优化的极简地图扩展，内置独立的原生质感设置面板。独家提供：通勤快线一键回家/公司、红绿灯与油费智能预估、接驾口令生成与天气简报。让你的每一次出行都干净、高效、充满艺术感。

window.jumpToAddr = async function(type) { const addr = localStorage.getItem('pro_addr_' + type); if(!addr) { const input = prompt('请先设置您的【' + type + '】地址（输入具体地点）：'); if(input) { localStorage.setItem('pro_addr_' + type, input); showToast('已保存 ' + type + ' 地址：' + input); } return; } showToast('正在为您导航至' + type + '...'); if(!config.webKey) return; try { const res = await fetch(`https://restapi.amap.com/v3/geocode/geo?address=${encodeURIComponent(addr)}&key=${config.webKey}`); const data = await res.json(); if(data.status === '1' && data.geocodes.length > 0) { const loc = data.geocodes[0].location.split(','); handlePlaceSelected({ name: type + ' (' + addr + ')', lng: Number(loc[0]), lat: Number(loc[1]) }); } else { showToast('找不到该地址，请重新设置'); localStorage.removeItem('pro_addr_' + type); } } catch(e) { showToast('搜索失败'); } }; window.addCustomSettings = function() { const scrollArea = document.getElementById('settingsScrollArea'); if(!scrollArea) return; if(document.getElementById('myCustomSettingItem')) return; const list = scrollArea.querySelectorAll('m3e-action-list'); if(list.length < 2) return; const newItem = document.createElement('m3e-list-action'); newItem.id = 'myCustomSettingItem'; newItem.innerHTML = `rocket_launch轻艺通勤 Pro红绿灯、通勤快线、天气与口令生成chevron_right`; newItem.onclick = function() { if(document.getElementById('myPluginPage')) return; const page = document.createElement('div'); page.id = 'myPluginPage'; page.style.cssText = 'position: fixed; inset: 0; background-color: var(--md-sys-color-surface-container) !important; z-index: 600; display: flex; flex-direction: column;'; page.innerHTML = `arrow_back轻艺 Pro 设置
🚀 轻艺功能说明
1. 通勤快线：主页一键回家/去公司。
2. 路况预估：红绿灯与油费智能测算。
3. 接驾口令：一键生成网约车定位文本。
4. 隐藏Logo与天气：个性扩展。
地图与隐私管理
warning隐藏高德Logo⚠️ 违反高德条款，请谨慎开启
神级扩展功能
directions_car计算油费预估按 0.8元/公里 估算traffic预测红绿灯数量根据距离智能估算partly_cloudy_day开启天气简报在主页显示指定城市实时天气
`; document.body.appendChild(page); document.getElementById('hideLogoSwitch').onchange = (e) => { localStorage.setItem('pro_hide_logo', e.target.checked); const styleTag = document.getElementById('zlm-hide-logo-style'); if(styleTag) { if(e.target.checked) { styleTag.removeAttribute('style'); } else { styleTag.setAttribute('style', 'display:none;'); } } }; document.getElementById('costEstSwitch').onchange = (e) => { localStorage.setItem('pro_cost', e.target.checked); }; document.getElementById('trafficLightSwitch').onchange = (e) => { localStorage.setItem('pro_traffic', e.target.checked); }; document.getElementById('weatherSwitch').onchange = (e) => { localStorage.setItem('ext_weather', e.target.checked); if(e.target.checked) { const city = prompt('请输入要显示天气的城市:', '北京'); if(city) { localStorage.setItem('ext_city', city); window.loadWeather(city); } else { e.target.checked = false; localStorage.setItem('ext_weather', 'false'); } } else { const card = document.getElementById('ext-weather-card'); if(card) card.remove(); } }; document.getElementById('myPluginBackBtn').onclick = function() { page.remove(); }; if(page.animate) page.animate([{transform:'translateX(100%)'},{transform:'translateX(0)'}], {duration:300, easing:'cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)'}); }; list[1].appendChild(newItem); }; window.loadWeather = async function(city) { if(!config || !config.webKey) { showToast('请先配置高德 Web Key'); return; } try { const res = await fetch(`https://restapi.amap.com/v3/weather/weatherInfo?key=${config.webKey}&city=${encodeURIComponent(city)}`); const data = await res.json(); if(data.status === '1' && data.lives && data.lives.length > 0) { const w = data.lives[0]; let card = document.getElementById('ext-weather-card'); if(!card) { card = document.createElement('div'); card.id = 'ext-weather-card'; card.className = 'zlm-injected-node'; card.style.marginTop = '12px'; const mapWrap = document.querySelector('.map-wrap'); mapWrap.parentNode.insertBefore(card, mapWrap); } card.innerHTML = `
partly_cloudy_day
${w.city} · ${w.weather}
${w.temperature}℃ · ${w.winddirection}风 ${w.windpower}级
`; } } } catch(e) { showToast('天气请求失败'); } }; setTimeout(() => { const styleTag = document.getElementById('zlm-hide-logo-style'); if(localStorage.getItem('pro_hide_logo') !== 'false' && styleTag) { styleTag.removeAttribute('style'); } window.addCustomSettings(); if(localStorage.getItem('ext_weather') === 'true') { window.loadWeather(localStorage.getItem('ext_city') || '北京'); } }, 1000);
